# Independent Review: [Feature]

Reviewer should not be the same session/agent that built the feature.

## Correctness
## Security (auth, authorization, tenant isolation, data leakage)
## Data integrity / race conditions
## Validation
## Error handling
## External integration failure handling
## Backward compatibility
## Tests (do they prove behavior, or just exist)
## Complexity (is this more than the smallest useful change)
## Scope (did implementation exceed the approved plan)

## Findings, by severity
CRITICAL:
HIGH:
MEDIUM:
LOW:

If none, say so explicitly rather than leaving a section blank.
